white.$description: Accretion UI utility white (#FFFFFF). Use for inverse text and icon treatments on dark surfaces or for neutral light fills. Accessibility: confirm contrast against adjacent colors, especially when white text appears on tinted backgrounds.

black.$description: Accretion UI utility black (#000000). Use for maximum-contrast text, icons, and overlays when strong emphasis is needed. Accessibility: avoid pure black on pure white for long reading blocks; prefer neutral text tones to reduce visual fatigue while keeping WCAG compliance.

transparent.$description: Accretion UI transparent utility color (#00000000). Use to preserve inherited backgrounds, masks, and gradient stops without adding visible pigment. Accessibility: always evaluate the resulting layered contrast because transparency can reduce readability unexpectedly.

sans.$value: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
sans.$description: Accretion UI primary sans-serif stack (Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif). Use for all default UI text including body copy, labels, and headings. Accessibility: keep fallback families intact to preserve legibility across platforms and avoid custom fonts that degrade character clarity.

mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
mono.$description: Accretion UI monospace stack ("JetBrains Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace). Use for code snippets, tabular numerals, and technical identifiers where fixed character width improves scanability. Accessibility: avoid long paragraphs in monospace to reduce reading fatigue.

regular.$description: Accretion UI font weight regular (400). Use as the default body text weight for sustained reading. Accessibility: avoid ultra-light text styles in UI copy; maintain sufficient size and contrast whenever using heavier or lighter emphasis.

medium.$description: Accretion UI font weight medium (500). Use for emphasized labels and dense UI metadata that need mild prominence. Accessibility: avoid ultra-light text styles in UI copy; maintain sufficient size and contrast whenever using heavier or lighter emphasis.

semibold.$description: Accretion UI font weight semibold (600). Use for section titles, active navigation labels, and button text needing stronger hierarchy. Accessibility: avoid ultra-light text styles in UI copy; maintain sufficient size and contrast whenever using heavier or lighter emphasis.

bold.$description: Accretion UI font weight bold (700). Use sparingly for high-priority headings and critical numeric emphasis. Accessibility: avoid ultra-light text styles in UI copy; maintain sufficient size and contrast whenever using heavier or lighter emphasis.

2xs.$description: Accretion UI font size 2xs (11px). Use for compact metadata, captions, and helper labels in dense interfaces. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

xs.$description: Accretion UI font size xs (12px). Use for compact metadata, captions, and helper labels in dense interfaces. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

sm.$description: Accretion UI font size sm (14px). Use for secondary body text and short-form labels. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

md.$description: Accretion UI font size md (16px). Use for default body text and form content. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

lg.$description: Accretion UI font size lg (18px). Use for prominent labels, section intros, and large body text. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

xl.$description: Accretion UI font size xl (20px). Use for prominent labels, section intros, and large body text. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

2xl.$description: Accretion UI font size 2xl (24px). Use for headings and display text with clear visual hierarchy. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

3xl.$description: Accretion UI font size 3xl (30px). Use for headings and display text with clear visual hierarchy. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

4xl.$description: Accretion UI font size 4xl (36px). Use for headings and display text with clear visual hierarchy. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

5xl.$description: Accretion UI font size 5xl (48px). Use for headings and display text with clear visual hierarchy. Accessibility: prefer 16px or larger for primary body text on touch devices and verify zoom/reflow behavior at 200%-400%.

2xs.$description: Accretion UI line height 2xs (16px). Use to maintain vertical rhythm for text set at the matching size scale. This pairs to a ~1.45 line-height ratio with font.size.2xs. Accessibility: keep paragraph line-height near 1.4-1.6 for long-form readability.

tighter.$description: Accretion UI letter spacing tighter (-0.02em). Use only for large display headlines where tight tracking improves visual cohesion. Accessibility: avoid tight tracking on small text and avoid excessive tracking for long sentences to preserve reading speed.

tight.$description: Accretion UI letter spacing tight (-0.01em). Use for short headings and compact labels that can tolerate slight tracking reduction. Accessibility: avoid tight tracking on small text and avoid excessive tracking for long sentences to preserve reading speed.

normal.$description: Accretion UI letter spacing normal (0em). Use as the default tracking for body text and most UI labels. Accessibility: avoid tight tracking on small text and avoid excessive tracking for long sentences to preserve reading speed.

wide.$description: Accretion UI letter spacing wide (0.01em). Use for uppercase labels or compact metadata where extra spacing improves recognition. Accessibility: avoid tight tracking on small text and avoid excessive tracking for long sentences to preserve reading speed.
